profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Twenty years of experience with kernel-level programming, software architecture, and design.

At Oracle, architect and developer of virtual memory subsystem components. Typical focus is on reliability, debuggability, performance, and scalability aspects of system-level software components. Interests include advanced debugging techniques, large scale software engineering, computer system architecture, and virtualization.

At VMware, worked on an advanced development project for the ESX platform, developing software which runs in VMkernel and virtual machine monitor environments.

At Sun Microsystems, designed and implemented core kernel components for Solaris kernel, and addressed a wide range of performance and scalability challenges in the Solaris virtual memory subsystem.

At Systran, implemented storage and network device drivers on Windows NT, Linux, IRIX, and Solaris platforms.

Specialties: Operating system kernel development, debugging, computer system architecture, performance, scalability, large scale software engineering, software reliability, and diagnosability

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Former Director of Operations.

Responsibilities included:

- Purchasing of raw materials to packaging of finished goods, and all points in-between, such as forecasting, production planning, and management of the production team
- Regulatory compliance
- Strategic planning for company growth

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior software engineer in Solaris Core Kernel development. Specialties: virtual memory, scalability, performance. Acting virtual memory tech lead.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Advanced development projects for ESX platform.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Solaris Kernel Development
positions.description: Operating system kernel development for Sun Microsystems Solaris platform. C and assembly on SPARC and x86 platforms. ccNUMA optimizations, trap handling, MMU synchronization, paging, memory allocation, fault recovery, memory management, performance optimization. Technical and team lead experience. ARC licensee, CRT member, OpenSolaris code sponsor.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: UNIX system administration. Device driver development in C for VxWorks, Linux, Solaris, Irix, Windows NT, and LynxOS for FibreChannel (raw FCP, block FCP, IP) and proprietary point-to-point high-speed datalink devices.

educations.fieldOfStudy: CS, EE, VLSI, FPGAs, Operating Systems, System Architecture

patents.title: Method and apparatus for memory management in a multi-processor computer system
